chapter.v:
The Lord
told Moses and Aaron,

“The Israelites
are to set up their camp around the Tent of Meeting but some distance from it. Every member of each tribe will camp under their own flag and family banner.

The tribal
division of Judah is to camp under their flag on the east side. Their leader is Nahshon, son of Amminadab,

and he
has 74,600 men.

The tribe
of Issachar will camp next to them. Their leader is Nethanel, son of Zuar,

and he
has 54,400 men.

Next is
the tribe of Zebulun. Their leader is Eliab, son of Helon,

and he
has 57,400 men.

So the
total number of men in the area of the camp of Judah is 186,400. When it's time to march out, they are the ones who will lead.

The tribal
division of Reuben is to camp under their flag on the south side. Their leader is Elizur, son of Shedeur,

and he
has 46,500 men.

The tribe
of Simeon will camp next to them. Their leader is Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai,

and he
has 59,300 men.

Next is
the tribe of Gad. Their leader is Eliasaph, son of Deuel,

and he
has 45,650 men.

So the
total number of men in the area of the camp of Reuben is 151,450. They shall march out in second place.

The Tent
of Meeting which stands at the center of the camp is to accompany the Levites. They are to march out in the same order as they set up camp, each in their rightful place under their flag.

The tribal
division of Ephraim is to camp under their flag on the west side. Their leader is Elishama, son of Ammihud,

and he
has 40,500 men.

The tribe
of Manasseh will camp next to them. Their leader is Gamaliel, son of Pedahzur,

and he
has 32,200 men.

Next is
the tribe of Benjamin. Their leader is Abidan, son of Gideoni,

and he
has 35,400 men.

So the
total number of men in the area of the camp of Ephraim is 108,100. They shall march out in third place

The tribal
division of Dan is to camp under their flag on the north side. Their leader is Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai,

and he
has 62,700 men.

The tribe
of Asher will camp next to them. Their leader is Pagiel, son of Ocran,

and he
has 41,500 men.

Next is
the tribe of Naphtali. Their leader is Ahira son of Enan,

and he
has 53,400 men.

So the
total number of men in the area of the camp of Dan is 157,600;. They shall march out last, with their flags.”

This sums
up the registration of the Israelites, carried out by family. The final total of those counted in the camps by their tribal division was 603,550.

However, the
Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, following the Lord's instructions to Moses.

The Israelites
did everything the Lord had ordered Moses. They set up their camps under their flags in their assigned positions, and marched out in the same order, each with their own tribe and family.
